## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes with 0 failures
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by a focused test
- [ ] Tests assert actual application behavior, not assumed exception types or substrings
- [ ] No field, route, score, or report output equivalent to `conscious = true`, `consciousness_probability`, `sentience_score`, or `qualia_detected` was introduced
- [ ] Self-reports are not promoted to evidence of phenomenal experience
- [ ] Any new metric includes a `does_not_establish` field
- [ ] Any new theory family is labeled as operationally inspired by, not an implementation of, a named academic theory
- [ ] Documentation accurately reflects the implementation — no unsupported scientific claims
- [ ] `git diff --check` is clean (no trailing whitespace)
